notes.title: Version 1.13Y Beta Available
notes.content:
The Version 1.13Y beta is now available.  As mentioned in the last post, we're attempting to rebuild code that was lost, and this build makes substantial progress toward that goal. This build also cleans up a number of bugs associated with the database and should increase the stability of the game.  See below for a description of the changes:

Version 1.13Y
Fixed: Recursion bug when quitting the game
Fixed: Cancelling a tour doesn't cancel a tour but still gives popularity loss
Fixed: The Screaming stat stuck displaying letter on Song Theme screen
Fixed: Relationships cannot be deleted via editor
Fixed: When running a Global label, the "Size" of your label on the Size screen no longer erroneously shows "International" as your next size
Fixed: Fixed the pop-up screens where clicking an X closes out of the game (If we missed any of these, please let us know!!)
Fixed: Various SQL bugs that may have slowed down the game and caused crashes
Change: Game automatically updates database files to latest version when starting or loading a game
Change: Added rounded rectangles to Chattr
Change: The Game now runs on 64-bit (this was also the case in the most recent build)

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
I just posted a small update (1.12x) in the beta section of the game. The update fixes the sales/stream bug caused by songs created in the game editor.  New songs created should now work. If you want to fix existing songs in the database, you need to select the database in the dropdown in the editor window. 

Unfortunately, this update and any future updates won’t work with the FM DLC, because I lost the source code for the latest version of the game (1.17).  As you can see, I’m starting from the version 1.12 and building back up from that.

You can access the beta by right clicking the game in your library and selecting properties.

tags.bug: The update fixes the sales/stream bug caused by songs created in the game editor.

notes.title: 1.16 Update Available
notes.content:
Version 1.16 is now available on Steam! The latest update (v1.16) includes new artist pictures and bios as well as a number of bug fixes.

Most Recent Changelog:

-Fixed the pop-up screens where clicking an X closes out of the game (If we missed any of these, please let us know!!)
-Sales/Chart info updates two weeks after the single/album's release
-Releasing an album from a retired artist no longer counts as an option
-Creating side project/solo projects from retired artists no longer causes the new project to be retired
-The "Approach" button is replaced with "Buy Catalogue" for retired artists
-Retired artists now stop receiving festival and award performance invites
-When running a Global label, the "Size" of your label on the Size screen no longer erroneously shows "International" as your next size
-Greyed out the buttons for already retired artist disabled features (like booking a tour, recording an album) that were displaying the incorrect graphic before
